$comment: [X4.3] Stripe MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `stripe` — official Stripe MCP server, com.stripe registry namespace; X1.7 evidence). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Auth via STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env (the local server also accepts `--api-key=`, but doctrine #6 forbids `=` in args, so the key is passed via env). CC0-1.0.
title: Stripe Payments & Billing
description: Create and inspect Stripe customers, products, prices, payment links, and invoices via the official Stripe MCP server.

env_vars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env_vars.description: Stripe API key. Strongly prefer a Restricted API Key (`rk_…`) scoped to the exact tool permissions you need over a full secret key (`sk_…`). Tool availability is bounded by the key's permissions; pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

auth.recipe: create a Restricted API Key (`rk_…`) at dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys with the desired tool permissions, then set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; use a test-mode key (`rk_test_…`) for development.

sample_tools.name: create_product
sample_tools.summary: Create a product in the catalog.

sample_tools.name: create_payment_link
sample_tools.summary: Create a shareable payment link for a price.

sample_tools.name: create_invoice
sample_tools.summary: Create an invoice for a customer.

sample_tools.name: search_documentation
sample_tools.summary: Search Stripe's documentation to answer an integration question.

sample_tools.name: retrieve_balance
sample_tools.summary: Retrieve the current Stripe account balance.

known_limitations: Requires a Stripe API key (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY); without it the server cannot authenticate and every tool returns an auth error.
Tool availability is bounded by the Restricted API Key's permissions — a read-only key cannot create customers, invoices, or payment links.
Operates against real Stripe data when given a live key (`sk_live_…` / `rk_live_…`); use a test-mode key for development to avoid real charges.

Destructive-action audit (X2.18): the server exposes no delete/destroy tools (`destructive_tools` is empty); financial mutations such as refunds still confirm per-call because the trust policy sets `allowDestructive: false` (X1.7 evidence).

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `stripe`: { command: npx, args: [-y, @stripe/mcp], env: { STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: "rk_..." } }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `stripe`, command `npx -y @stripe/mcp`; set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `stripe` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply STRIPE_SECRET_KEY via inputs.
